configurable_props.name: campaignId
configurable_props.label: Campaign ID
configurable_props.description: The unique ID of the campaign

configurable_props.name: listId
configurable_props.label: List Id
configurable_props.description: The unique ID of the list

configurable_props.name: savedSegmentId
configurable_props.label: Saved segment ID
configurable_props.description: The ID for an existing saved segment.

configurable_props.name: prebuiltSegmentId
configurable_props.label: Prebuilt segment ID
configurable_props.description: The prebuilt segment ID, if a prebuilt segment has been designated for this campaign.

configurable_props.name: segmentMatch
configurable_props.label: Segment match
configurable_props.description: Segment match type.

configurable_props.name: segmentConditions
configurable_props.label: Segment condition
configurable_props.description: Segment match conditions.

configurable_props.name: subjectLine
configurable_props.label: Subject line
configurable_props.description: The subject line for the campaign.

configurable_props.name: previewText
configurable_props.label: Preview text
configurable_props.description: The preview text for the campaign.

configurable_props.name: title
configurable_props.label: Title
configurable_props.description: The title of the campaign.

configurable_props.name: fromName
configurable_props.label: From name
configurable_props.description: The 'from' name on the campaign (not an email address).

configurable_props.name: replyTo
configurable_props.label: Reply to
configurable_props.description: The reply-to email address for the campaign. Note: while this field is not required for campaign creation, it is required for sending.

configurable_props.name: useConversation
configurable_props.label: Use conversations
configurable_props.description: Use Mailchimp Conversation feature to manage out-of-office replies.

configurable_props.name: toName
configurable_props.label: To name
configurable_props.description: The campaign's custom 'To' name.

configurable_props.name: folderId
configurable_props.label: Folder ID
configurable_props.description: If the campaign is listed in a folder, the ID for that folder.

configurable_props.name: authenticate
configurable_props.label: Authenticate
configurable_props.description: Whether Mailchimp authenticated the campaign. Defaults to true.

configurable_props.name: autoFooter
configurable_props.label: Auto footer
configurable_props.description: Automatically append Mailchimp's default footer to the campaign.

configurable_props.name: inlineCss
configurable_props.label: Inline css
configurable_props.description: Automatically inline the CSS included with the campaign content.

configurable_props.name: autoTweet
configurable_props.label: Auto tweet
configurable_props.description: Automatically tweet a link to the campaign archive page when the campaign is sent.

configurable_props.name: autoFbPost
configurable_props.label: Auto facebook post
configurable_props.description: An array of Facebook page ID to auto-post to.

configurable_props.name: fbComments
configurable_props.label: Facebook comment
configurable_props.description: Allows Facebook comments on the campaign (also force-enables the Campaign Archive toolbar). Defaults to true.

configurable_props.name: templateId
configurable_props.label: Template ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the template to use.

configurable_props.name: opens
configurable_props.label: Opens
configurable_props.description: Whether to track opens. Defaults to true. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

configurable_props.name: htmlClicks
configurable_props.label: HTML clicks
configurable_props.description: Whether to track clicks in the HTML version of the campaign. Defaults to true. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

configurable_props.name: textClicks
configurable_props.label: Text clicks
configurable_props.description: Whether to track clicks in the plain-text version of the campaign. Defaults to true. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

configurable_props.name: goalTracking
configurable_props.label: Goal tracking
configurable_props.description: Whether to enable Goal tracking.

configurable_props.name: ecomm360
configurable_props.label: E-commerce tracking
configurable_props.description: Whether to enable eCommerce360 tracking.

configurable_props.name: googleAnalytics
configurable_props.label: Google analytics
configurable_props.description: The custom slug for Google Analytics tracking (max of 50 bytes).

configurable_props.name: clicktale
configurable_props.label: Clicktale
configurable_props.description: The custom slug for ClickTale tracking (max of 50 bytes).

configurable_props.name: salesforceCampaign
configurable_props.label: Salesforce campaign
configurable_props.description: Create a campaign in a connected Salesforce account.

configurable_props.name: salesforceNotes
configurable_props.label: Salesforce notes
configurable_props.description: Update contact notes for a campaign based on subscriber email addresses.

configurable_props.name: capsuleNotes
configurable_props.label: Capsule notes
configurable_props.description: Update contact notes for a campaign based on subscriber email addresses. Must be using Mailchimp's built-in Capsule integration.

configurable_props.name: socialImageUrl
configurable_props.label: Social image url
configurable_props.description: The url for the header image for the preview card.

configurable_props.name: socialDescritpion
configurable_props.label: Social description
configurable_props.description: A short summary of the campaign to display.

configurable_props.name: socialTitle
configurable_props.label: Social title
configurable_props.description: The title for the preview card. Typically the subject line of the campaign.
